explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 93 named tracks/releases across Boomkat's September 14 new-release pages, Juno's complete current-techno page, current label/artist pages and an overlooked catalogue/reissue window. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized without creating a blanket intensity or genre ban.

Completed discovery Runs 239–245 and persistent target/global discovery state were compared before ranking. Previously evaluated, parked, rejected, unresolved, duplicate and exact-alternate identities were excluded.
All ranked artist/title pairs were checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger; none was found.

Five Paired Works tracks are retained because Boomkat describes them individually and the source resolves their separate artist credits. They are independently placed and must receive independent verdicts; same-release membership is not evidence of fit.
No proposed placement touches either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
rankedLeadSummary: 8. Antonio Fevola — If The Choice Was Mine
sourceWindows: CURRENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Justine Perry and Paula Koski — Paired Works, newly surfaced on Boomkat's September 14 page; release metadata and artist credits cross-checked against Kompakt. https://boomkat.com/products/paired-works · https://kompakt.fm/releases/paired_works

CURRENT CLUB WINDOW: Patrik Berg/Exzess, Antonio Fevola/Analogue Network and Funkhaus/Transition on current Juno and label pages. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/this-week/ · https://analoguenetwork.bandcamp.com/ · https://transitionofc.bandcamp.com/
OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / REISSUE WINDOW: Steve Bug — Back From Eternity, originally released 2024 and newly visible in the current Dubwax vinyl window. https://dbh-music.bandcamp.com/
